---
title: "Code from files: R"
---

Ways to bring code that lives in `.R` files into a document.

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_code/_common.R")
```

## A hidden setup file (the r4ds pattern)

`_code/_common.R` was sourced by a hidden chunk at the top:

```{r}
common_loaded
```

## `file:` chunk option

knitr reads the chunk's code from the file: shown and run.

```{r}
#| file: _code/helpers.R
```

```{r}
moving_average(1:6)
```

## Include shortcode inside a code chunk

```{r}
{{< include _code/helpers.R >}}
greeting
```

## Named sections of a script (`knitr::read_chunk`)

```{r}
#| include: false
knitr::read_chunk("_code/helpers.R")
```

```{r}
#| label: greeting
```

```{r}
greeting
```

## `code:` from an expression

```{r}
#| code: !expr readLines("_code/helpers.R")[3:5]
```

## Show a file without running it

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| file: _code/helpers.R
```
